import pandas as pd

# Source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length1_55/training_0.csv"
]

# List to hold dataframes from all sources
dfs = []

# Load each source file, transform and collect
for file_path in source_files:
    # Read CSV with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    
    # Source schema: ['J_CALL']
    # Target schema: ['V_GENE']
    # Transformation: Extract the part before '*' from J_CALL to get V_GENE
    df['V_GENE'] = df['J_CALL'].str.split('*').str[0]
    
    # Select only the target column
    df_target = df[['V_GENE']]
    
    dfs.append(df_target)

# Since all source tables have the same schema and target schema is the same,
# union (concat) all dataframes vertically
result_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Write the result to the target path
result_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_55/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
